sentences.text: 3 3. In respect of matrimonial differences parties had filed number of petitions before the District Judiciary and Family Court both civil and criminal.
4. In M.C.No.1883/2022, the parties were referred to mediation.
Parties appeared before the learned mediator and settled their dispute amicably and a settlement deed was signed by the parties and their respective counsels which was acted upon.
One of the conditions that has been incorporated in the said agreement is to bring the criminal prosecution to a logical end.
As such, a petition is filed before this Court in Criminal Petition No.100775/2023.

5. Parties agree that the settlement before the learned mediator is a true settlement and these two petitions are also to be allowed in terms of the compromise petition and the dispute be put to rest.

6. Since the parties have already settled their dispute amicably and an agreement was also signed C/W CRL.P NO. 100775 OF 2023 before the learned mediator which was acted upon and as a final settlement alimony is also paid, following the dictum of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ramgopal and another vs. state of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2021 SCC online SC 834, following order is passed:
ORDER
